_meta.note: v1.8.3.20 Phase 2 - i18n groundwork. English is the source language: this file is the ORIGIN of these strings, not a translation of them. A locale file is added by copying this one and translating the values; keys never change.
_meta.scope: Migrated so far: the auto-mode surface (dashboard mode + pick card, activity strip, player Auto tab, filter suggestion). See docs/I18N.md for what is deliberately still inline and why.

auto.mode.title: Auto mode
auto.mode.desc.on: Model is chosen per video from content, resolution and what your hardware can run.
auto.mode.desc.off: Your manual model, scale and filter settings apply exactly as configured.
auto.mode.dashboard.on: Auto: the model is chosen per video from content type, resolution and what your hardware can run. A filter is only ever suggested - never applied for you. Flip off for Custom.
auto.mode.dashboard.off: Custom: your manual model/scale/filter settings apply exactly as configured.
auto.mode.toast.on: Auto mode on - models are picked per video
auto.card.default: Default pick - start playback for this file
auto.card.unavailable: No decision available - the AI service did not answer. Auto never blocks playback: your configured model is used instead.
auto.card.loading: Reading the decision for this video…
auto.controls.title: Live controls
auto.controls.subtitle: applies immediately
auto.controls.filters.yours: Your preset: {preset} - auto only suggests, never overwrites
auto.controls.filters.none: Auto may suggest a look for this content
auto.controls.face.desc: {model} - sharpens faces, costs extra time per frame
auto.controls.realtime.desc: Upscale during playback instead of only in batch jobs
auto.suggest.label: Suggested look
player.notice.lookSuggested: look suggested in the Auto tab
